title: Broker or dealer
description: A single broker or dealer who arranged the Movement. organisationName and contactDetails are required, and exactly one of registrationNumber or reasonForNoRegistrationNumber must be provided. address is optional.

organisationName.description: Name of the broker or dealer organisation who arranged this Movement.

registrationNumber.description: Waste carrier, broker or dealer registration number, in a valid UK home-nation format (England and NRW CBDU/CBDL, SEPA WCR/SCO/SEA/SNO/SWE and PCT, NI ROC UT/LT). Exactly one of 'registrationNumber' or 'reasonForNoRegistrationNumber' is required.

reasonForNoRegistrationNumber.description: Why there is no registration number. Exactly one of 'registrationNumber' or 'reasonForNoRegistrationNumber' is required.

contactDetails.description: How to contact the broker or dealer.
